originStatement: Hand-authored inside spfn-mobile during Step 2. NOT exported by SPFN primitives CI. Upstream export tooling does not exist yet; when it does, it replaces this file wholesale and this bundle is deleted rather than edited.

canonicalJson.numbers: signed 64-bit integers only; a fractional or non-finite number is a canonicalization error
canonicalJson.stringEscapes: quotation mark and reverse solidus escaped; C0 controls use \b \f \n \r \t where defined and \u00XX otherwise; every other scalar is emitted literally

proofInput.fieldRules: no field value may contain a C0 control character; a value that does is a proof-input error, because the separator would otherwise be ambiguous
proofInput.bodySha256: lowercase base16 SHA-256 of the canonical JSON request body; the literal string of 64 zero characters when an operation has no body

clientProofV1.replayRule: a (clientId, nonce) pair is accepted at most once inside the replay window; a repeat is PROOF_REPLAYED
clientProofV1.revocationRule: a revoked keyId is rejected before the proof is verified; the outcome is SESSION_REVOKED and never PROOF_INVALID, so revocation is distinguishable from a bad proof

operations.summary: Presents a client proof and opens a session.
Authenticated round trip used as the smallest real vertical slice.
Authenticated paged read covering optional fields and arrays.

errorEnvelope.unknownCodeRule: a code outside this list is never mapped to a neighbouring code; it surfaces as an unknown-code failure carrying the raw string

errors.summary: the client proof did not verify
the nonce was already used inside the replay window
issuedAtMillis falls outside the replay window
the key or session was revoked
an auth profile outside the allowlist was named
the server contract version is outside the range this SDK declares support for

notes: This bundle contains no secret, no real key and no production endpoint. Paths are shapes, not deployed routes.
It exists so Step 2 can prove a real vertical slice: one pinned digest, one generator, two platforms, one set of fixtures.
The single authority for the production contract remains SPFN primitives. This file is a development stand-in with an honest provenance record in Contracts/upstream.lock.json.
